title: Design System: Beat Saber Mapping Utility

motion.name: tool-link-state
motion.purpose: Transition tool-link background and text colors.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable transitions and animations and use automatic scroll behavior.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Raised-surface action button for standard tool controls.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.125rem; font: italic 600 1.2rem/1.1 var(--font-display); text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-button { min-height: 2.75rem; } }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Accent-filled action for the primary operation in a tool.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.125rem; font: italic 600 1.2rem/1.1 var(--font-display); text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-accent); background: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-button-primary { min-height: 2.75rem; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled field with visible focus and invalid-input treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; min-width: 0; font: 600 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-body); } .ds-input { width: 100%; max-width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font: 1rem/1.5 var(--font-body); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text); background: var(--input); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 2px; caret-color: var(--accent); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--danger); } .ds-input:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--muted); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-input { min-height: 2.75rem; } }

components.name: Tool Panel
components.description: Title-only bordered panel with padded content. Inputs, results, reference data, and JSON editors stay visible without collapsible sections.
components.html:
Effective BPM & Precision

Tool controls and results
components.css: .ds-tool-panel { min-width: 0; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-tool-header { padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider); } .ds-tool-header h2 { margin: 0; font: italic 600 2rem/1.1 var(--font-display); text-transform: uppercase; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-tool-content { padding: 1.25rem; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-tool-panel { scroll-margin-top: 1rem; } } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-tool-header, .ds-tool-content { padding: 1rem; } .ds-tool-header h2 { font-size: 1.75rem; } }

components.name: Tool Navigation Tab
components.description: Vertical hash-linked tabs in the desktop rail. At 900px and below, the menu button opens the same list in a left-side modal drawer.
components.html: EBPM & Precision
components.css: .ds-tool-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.125rem; } .ds-tool-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.5rem; color: var(--muted); border: 1px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-tool-tab > span { min-width: 0; } .ds-tool-title { display: block; font: italic 600 1.3rem/1.1 var(--font-display); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tool-tab svg { width: 1.4rem; height: 1.4rem; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-tool-tab:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); text-decoration: none; } .ds-tool-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--divider); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-surface); } .ds-tool-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 1150px) { .ds-tool-tab { padding-inline: 0.5rem; gap: 0.6rem; } } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-tool-tab { min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem; } .ds-tool-title { font-size: 1.15rem; } .ds-tool-tab svg { width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tool-tab { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
This is a companion instrument panel for Beat Saber mappers. In Dark, layered blue-black surfaces and steel rules keep the tools focused while cyan marks action, focus, and selection. Light shifts to cool, pale surfaces and deep teal; Monochrome reduces the palette to black, white, and gray. All three themes preserve the same semantic roles. Depth comes from tonal surfaces and borders, not gradients or shadows.

Operational headings, tool labels, and actions use locally hosted Teko; explanations stay in a system sans-serif, while numeric results use tabular figures. The workspace shows one utility at a time. Selecting another tool updates its stable URL hash and hides the other panels without discarding their inputs.
keyCharacteristics: Three selectable semantic palettes: Dark, Light, and Monochrome.
Italic uppercase Teko for operational hierarchy; system sans-serif for explanations; tabular numeric output.
One active tool panel, with a desktop rail that opens as a left-side drawer on compact screens.
Near-square controls and panels, steel dividers, restrained accent selection, and no decorative chrome.
dos: Do keep the Dark, Light, and Monochrome palettes on the same semantic color roles.
Do use Teko for operational headings, tool labels, and actions; keep explanations in the system sans-serif.
Do keep focus, selection, input, result, and invalid feedback clear within the active tool panel.
Do preserve the existing favicon and note/bomb artwork as product assets.
donts: Don't add gradients, drop shadows, or decorative illustrations.
Don't replace the near-square rounded.sm shape with pill controls or oversized rounded cards.
Don't turn the tools into a decorative card grid or remove their stable hash navigation.
